header.name: Champion Lines
header.description: v1.0.0 - Foals keep their parents' best stats: each stat has a 60% chance to come from the better parent.

modules.description: Overrides the horse and mule with one component group per stat value, so a script can set a foal's exact stats.

settings.text: §lChampion Lines§r - foals take after their parents instead of drifting back to average.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r
Show stats when you look at a horse
settings.name: horsebreed:show_stats

settings.text: Show parents when you look at a horse
settings.name: horsebreed:show_parents

settings.text: §7On: health and speed show once a horse has been ridden, and jump shows the best jump seen. Off: the true stats show.§r
§7Donkeys stay vanilla but get names and papers. A mule takes each stat from its horse or donkey parent by the same chance.§r
Chance to inherit the better parent's stat (%)
settings.name: horsebreed:chance

settings.text: §7Health, speed and jump are rolled separately. 50 is a coin toss; 100 always keeps the better value.§r
§7Use a book on a horse to get a signed book of its papers: name, color, parents, breeder, birthday and stats.§r
